items.html: And this is the secret of the letter Yod in its filling, which has in it the letters Dalet-Vav — Dalet on Vav, as mentioned in Parashat Vayikra, page 10b. And the Dalet is the four Tikunim of the Atika, drawn over the letter Vav, which is ZA, which at first was VAK alone, and afterwards were added to him other NHY, which were renewed for him, and he became nine; and now he is completed to the thirteen Tikunim of the beard, which are the secret of the three times Eheyeh mentioned above, in the three Alpins of the filling of MA of the third head. And the thirteenth correction includes all the twelve, like the example that we explained in the beard of the Atika.
